company.name: Lune
company.shortDescription: Lune is a single integration that unlocks the power of financial data, enabling institutions.
company.description:
Lune Technologies is a leading financial technology company specializing in transaction enrichment and financial data analytics for banks and fintechs. The company enables financial institutions to transform raw transactional data into structured, actionable insights that support smarter decision-making, operational efficiency, and enhanced customer experiences.

Powered by AI-driven technology, Lune Technologies delivers solutions across the entire transaction value chain, helping organizations better understand customer behavior, improve financial data accuracy, and unlock new revenue opportunities. Its platform enriches transaction data with meaningful merchant, category, and behavioral intelligence, allowing institutions to offer more personalized and user-centric financial services.

By turning complex financial data into clear, usable intelligence, Lune helps banks and fintechs strengthen customer engagement, optimize product strategies, improve risk analysis, and build more data-intelligent ecosystems. The company’s solutions are designed to help financial institutions remain agile, innovative, and future-ready in an increasingly digital financial landscape.
